items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard that about Erroll Garner. Well, I did a demo with Nan Grady and he … he read the tune, man, you know?

ctx.x: Well, he read poorly, but he read. I mean, that … but … let's just put a pin right there. I know you're asking the questions as an interested observer with no opinion of your own; and that's okay. That's your role. But it always bothers me when that's called to describe the music of a jazz player … that he can't read music. I heard that about Erroll Garner. Well, I did a demo with Nan Grady and he … he read the tune, man, you know? I think the difference, Devra, is that jazz players have such great memories and…
I kind of wondered if the inability or – maybe he read a little bit or whatever – but whether that frees someone from not feeling …
